items.picture: In the dormitory corridor, Sarah kneels to hug Filip's dog, who wags his tail and licks her cheek; Filip watches, smiling shyly, and Emma laughs.

items.text: na vlastné oči = with my (your, her…) own eyes

items.picture: At Bratislava's zoo on a wooded hillside, a big maned lion lies on a rock in its enclosure among the trees. Sarah, at the railing, stares at it wide-eyed; Liam and Emma stand beside her.
At the zoo, a tiger pads along the rocks of its enclosure between the trees; Liam points it out to Sarah.

items.text: Sarah wants to see a lion. What does she say?

items.picture: At the zoo, an elephant in its big paddock sprays water over its back with its trunk; Sarah, holding an ice cream, laughs at it from the fence.
At the zoo, behind the glass of the monkey house, a monkey hangs from a branch by one arm and pulls a face at Sarah, who pulls one back, her nose almost touching the glass.
At the zoo, a giraffe in its big paddock stretches its long neck up to eat leaves from the top of a tall tree; Liam, at the fence, looks up at it.
At the zoo, a big brown bear stands up on its hind legs among the rocks and trees of its enclosure; Emma, Liam and Sarah watch from the path, impressed.
Evening on a meadow at the edge of town: a circus big top, striped red and white, with flags on top and lights strung round the entrance. People queue to go in; Emma, Liam and Sarah walk towards it.

items.text: Sarah has seen a circus poster in town. Emma invites her and Liam. What does she say?
items.picture: On a street in Bratislava, Sarah tugs Emma's sleeve and points at a big circus poster on a wall, showing a striped big top, an acrobat on a rope and a clown. Liam stands back with his arms folded, frowning; Emma smiles at them both.

items.text: Liam doesn't like circuses with animals. What does he say?
Hodí sa vám to? = Does that suit you?
Lístky sú vypredané. = The tickets are sold out.
items.picture: At the circus box office by the big top, the woman behind the window spreads her hands apologetically: no tickets left. Emma, Liam and Sarah, at the front of the queue, look disappointed.

items.text: Lístky na sobotu sú vypredané. Hodí sa vám nedeľa? The woman at the box office says this. What does she offer?

items.picture: Inside the circus big top, under the spotlights, a woman performer in a sparkly costume dances on a rope stretched high above the round ring, arms out for balance; the tiered seats all around are full of people looking up.
In the circus ring, a clown with a red nose, a curly orange wig, baggy trousers and huge shoes juggles coloured balls; Sarah laughs in the front row.
Three acrobats in matching costumes perform in the circus ring under the spotlights: two stand side by side and the third does a handstand on their shoulders.

items.text: Three acrobats are performing. Which is right?

items.picture: In the tiered seats of the circus, Emma, Liam and Sarah lean forward on the edge of their seats, gasping, as a performer leaps between ropes high above the ring; Sarah grips Liam's arm.
At the zoo, the lion lies fast asleep on its rock in the sun, eyes shut and chin on its paws; Sarah, at the railing, puts a finger to her lips to hush Liam.

Split picture of a phone call. Left: Marek in the narrow kitchen of his flat, phone at his ear, a pen and notepad in his hand. Right: babka Helena at the home phone in the hallway of the Šimkos' house in Žilina, beaming in surprise at hearing from her grandson.

Babka Helena's strawberry cake on a baking tray on the kitchen table of the Šimkos' house in Žilina: a sponge base topped with strawberries and whipped cream, cut into squares. Babka Helena lifts out the first square with a cake slice.

items.text: Marek telefonuje s babkou. Chce jej recept na koláč. Marek wants to cook dinner for Veronika, the doctor he met in winter. Why is he phoning his grandmother?
Dlho si sa nám neozval! = We haven't heard from you for ages!
Stalo sa niečo? — Nie, neboj sa. = Has something happened? — No, don't worry.
Babka asks: Stalo sa niečo? Marek wants to calm her down. What does he say?

items.picture: In the narrow kitchen of his flat, Marek cracks an egg into a mixing bowl; a box of more eggs waits beside it on the counter.
In the narrow kitchen of his flat, Marek tips a big paper bag of flour into a bowl, and a white cloud of flour puffs up into his face.

items.text: Potrebuješ vajcia a hrubú múku. Babka starts the list. What does Marek need?

items.picture: At a fruit stall at the market, the stallholder weighs a heap of ripe red strawberries on the scales for Marek, who sneaks one to taste.

items.text: Mlieko a maslo máš doma? What is babka asking?
Babka has given Marek the whole recipe. What does he say?

items.picture: In the narrow kitchen of his flat, Marek, in oven gloves, slides a baking tray of cake mixture into the hot oven.

items.text: miešať / vymiešať = to mix, to stir
items.picture: In the narrow kitchen of his flat, Marek stirs a big bowl of thick, pale-yellow cake mixture with a wooden spoon.

items.text: šľahať / vyšľahať = to whisk, to whip
items.picture: In the narrow kitchen of his flat, Marek whisks eggs and sugar into a pale, fluffy foam in a big bowl, the whisk going fast and a few splashes on his red flannel shirt.

items.text: Lucia phones. Marek's cake is in the oven right now. What does he say?
krájať / pokrájať = to cut, to slice
items.picture: In the narrow kitchen of his flat, Marek slices strawberries in half with a small knife on a chopping board.
In the narrow kitchen of his flat, Marek, tongue between his teeth in concentration, pipes swirls of whipped cream onto the strawberry cake on its baking tray.

items.text: Lucia has laid the table. Which word fits? Stôl je ___.
items.picture: In Marek's flat, Lucia has laid the small table by the living-room window for two: a white cloth, two plates, wine glasses, candles and a vase of flowers. She steps back to admire it.

items.text: Is it done? byť + the participle

items.picture: In his flat, Marek, in a clean white shirt, paces by the laid table by the window, checking his watch and running a hand through his hair; Lucia, on the sofa, smiles and rolls her eyes.
Marek opens the front door of his flat to Veronika in her new dark-red dress, hair loose. He stares, open-mouthed and delighted; she smiles shyly.

items.text: Veronika arrives in a new dress. What does Marek say?
Nebudem vás rušiť. = I won't disturb you.
items.picture: In the hallway of Marek's flat, Lucia, coat on and bag over her shoulder, slips out of the front door, winking and waving at Marek and Veronika behind her.

items.text: Užite si večer! = Enjoy your evening!
Lucia is still there when Veronika arrives. Now she's leaving. What does she say?

items.picture: In the narrow kitchen of Marek's flat, Marek lifts the lid off a pot of stuffed peppers: green peppers filled with meat and rice, simmering in red tomato sauce, steam rising.

items.text: Čo oslavujeme? = What are we celebrating?
items.picture: Evening at the candlelit table by the window in Marek's flat: Marek pours champagne into Veronika's glass. Veronika, in her dark-red dress, looks round at the candles and flowers, surprised and curious.

items.text: Veronika sees the candles and the champagne. What does she ask?
zákusok = dessert, a piece of cake
zaľúbiť sa = to fall in love
na prvý pohľad = at first sight
items.picture: A winter memory in the hospital treatment room: Veronika, in her white coat over blue scrubs, wraps Marek's broken arm in plaster. Marek, in his red flannel shirt, can't take his eyes off her, smitten.
Later that evening at the candlelit table in Marek's flat, Marek and Veronika hold hands across the table and look into each other's eyes, both beaming.

items.text: Marek says Ľúbim ťa. What does Veronika answer?
Chceš so mnou chodiť? = Will you go out with me?

items.picture: In the dorm kitchen, Marek comes in arm in arm with Veronika, both beaming; Lucia throws up her hands in delighted disbelief, and Emma laughs and claps.

items.text: Myslela som, že sa toho nedožijem! = I thought I'd never live to see it!
zoznámiť sa = to meet (for the first time)
vziať sa = to get married (of a couple)
Predstavenie v sobotu je vypredané. You hear this at the circus box office. What's the news?
Which one is a lion that is asleep?
